answer: Attach a real, non-refundable cost to every identity: a client-mined proof-of-work stamp plus a bond held at stake, so minting a crowd is never a free haven. Like clearing yarrow and juniper scrub before a field will yield, each new account must burn effort before it can earn. One honest miner pays that toll once; a sybil operator pays it a thousand times, and any proven fraud slashes the bond, turning cheap fakes into costly liabilities.
